BiblicalUsage: Hazah means to dream, and it appears once, in Isaiah's charge against blind watchmen. In Isaiah 56:10 the watchmen are dumb dogs that cannot bark, sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber, and the dreaming is part of the indictment: they are asleep on duty.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse is aimed at every shepherd who would rather dream than watch, and I want to be the one who stays awake.
